Patient guide

Teeth whitening.

A brighter smile, done safely.

Why teeth stain.

Coffee, tea, red wine, tobacco, and time can all dull your smile.

A quick check first.

We make sure your teeth and gums are healthy. Fillings and crowns don't whiten.

Two ways to whiten.

In-office whitening for fast results, or custom trays to use at home.

In-officeTake-home trays

Whitening gel.

A professional gel gently lifts stains from deep within the enamel.

Brighter results.

Mild sensitivity is common and usually fades within a day or two.

Keep it bright.

A few simple habits help your results last.

Rinse after coffee or teaRegular cleaningsTouch-ups as needed

Questions? Just ask.

Your dental team is happy to walk you through every step.
